_comment: Legacy of the Dragonborn (Nexus 11802), optional: the Guild credits its repeatable relic work. LotD pays its own reward; the Guild adds a report worth a missive of the quest's rank (Merit and Reputation, no gold), counted with the missives. Read only while the plugin is loaded; nothing of LotD is mastered, copied or overridden. formId: local to the plugin; done: the stage that completes the quest (each time it runs). Checked against LotD 5.5.2 and 5.6.5. The names are for reading only (the game's own is shown).
